method: Sources were ENUMERATED before any value was extracted, and every source consulted is listed, including those that yielded nothing usable. Each cell's verbatim_quote was checked by script against the fetched artifact (discussion comment JSON, README / CSV at a fixed commit, page HTML); three were re-checked independently against the live source before commit. No source authored by this project (TR108-TR137) is used: grading against numbers the planner was fitted on is not a test. The mapping block on each cell is the planner identity the cell is scored as; inclusion rules are applied by scripts/build_validation_corpus.py, not by hand, and every exclusion is published with its reason.
